verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs say its CDN caches files close to users (Vercel Blob), that images are served from the CDN, and that CDN requests and data transfer are billed resources. Together these show a first-party CDN with edge caching for static assets. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on static-asset edge caching behavior (cache-control and invalidation), evidence of global PoP coverage or performance figures, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve static assets faster using a global CDN with edge caching

citations.quote: Vercel's CDN caches your files close to your users.
